title: Ziffr Pack (ziffr.pack/2)
description: A Pack as ziffr.pack/1, which may also name the Positions people fill when it is set up and the parts made once per line (Repeats), add those up in Totals, say where each number comes from, credit the Packs it builds on and carry a Pack Guide.

id.description: the creator's Marketplace handle and a slug, such as “ziffr/saas-metrics”, the same for every version

name.description: plain text, without markup or web addresses

version.description: three numbers, major, minor and patch, such as “1.2.0”

summary.description: plain text, without markup or web addresses

name.description: plain text, without markup or web addresses

license.description: CC-BY-4.0 or MIT for a free Pack, Ziffr-Pack-1.0 for a paid one.

ziffr.description: the oldest Ziffr that can install it, such as “>=0.12”

audience.description: Whom the Pack is for, so Ziffr can suggest it to a Workspace that fits and rank it higher. It never hides the Pack from anyone. Every part is optional and lists distinct keys from Ziffr's fixed lists; at least one part is needed (leave the field out instead of leaving it empty). A Pack that uses it must state a `ziffr` minimum, such as ">=0.16", since an older Ziffr refuses the field.

segments.description: who the business sells to or serves

functions.description: the Business Functions it is for

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes, such as “DE”

logo.description: The Pack's one logo, as a PNG, JPEG or plain SVG data address: at most 128,000 bytes and 512 pixels on each side. Shown only in a bordered box on the Packs page and the Marketplace; Themes of the Pack may use it with "logo": "pack".

listing.description: The only place a Pack may hold web addresses, shown on its pages as plain links.

feeds.description: Which of Ziffr's n8n templates fill which of the Pack's Metric Catalog entries (spec 0043). Only ids Ziffr ships are accepted. Installing makes nothing of it: after Set up, the page offers the download for the Metrics made from the entries. A Pack that uses it should say so in its `ziffr` minimum version.

template.description: the id of one of the templates Ziffr ships, such as “google-sheets”

items.description: the key of a Metric Catalog entry of this Pack the template fills

contents.description: What installing adds. Nothing in it may hold a web address.

metrics.description: Metric Catalog entries, each a ziffr.metric/1 or ziffr.metric/2 document under “metric”.

key.description: a key unique in the Pack and kept across its versions: lower-case letters, digits and dashes

per.description: the key of one of the Pack's Repeats: the item is made once for each of its lines

items.description: the key of one of the Pack's Positions

submitters.description: Positions that submit the Metric's values.

standIn.description: the key of a Position for one person, who stands in for the Submitters

viewers.description: Positions Set up proposes to share the Metric with, as Viewers.

editors.description: Positions Set up proposes to share the Metric with, as Editors.

total.description: Makes the entry a Total: a Derived Metric that adds up the Metrics made from one entry of a Repeat, in place of a formula. It takes no values. A Pack cannot open a Total to people who do not see every part.

of.description: the key of a Metric Catalog entry of this Pack with “per”, whose Metrics the Total adds up

targets.description: The Total's target: its own, or the targets of its parts added up.

comesFrom.description: Where the entry's number comes from, shown before installing, in Help and at Set up: “by” a “person” who types it, another “system” that sends it, or a “target” it is set once as. With “system” only, and needed then, the kind of system, such as “CRM”. A “note” of at most 300 characters may say more, such as where in that system the number is found. Not on a Derived Metric or a Total, which Ziffr calculates.
